_bridge_label: launchd label of the lane bridge (lanes/bridge.py); it runs only while a lane in lanes.json has a bridge member.
_bridge_port: Loopback port of the lane bridge; the pool reaches bridge lane members through it. Must differ from port; left out while port is 8320, it is 8321.
_headline: What the headline % covers: "all" (every seat that is not off, reserve seats included, weighted by size) or "regular" (reserve seats left out).
headline: all
_display: How every number and bar reads: "left" (counts down from 100%, bars drain) or "used" (counts up from 0%, bars fill).
_balancing: Which seat new threads get: "priority" (your fill order: codexpool order; the first seat until it runs out, then the next) or "reset" (the regular seat whose weekly quota resets soonest, so none of it goes to waste; the guard keeps the order up to date and the reserve stays last).
